description: Daily meditation sessions (twice per day) with heart rate variability tracking were implemented as a formal mission activity and human factors study element.
response: Crew reported positive wellbeing effects. The practice continued throughout simulation.
lesson: Formal wellbeing practices are operationally important in extreme isolation environments, not optional extras. Consider building a brief daily crew wellbeing check-in into the fixed mission schedule.
